prompts.background: Edit target: the attached existing game title illustration. Produce a CLEAN BACKGROUND PLATE for a layered animated game title. Keep the same widescreen composition, camera, blue-green 3D storybook dungeon architecture, stone arches, hanging banners, glowing turquoise crystals, central flagstone corridor, foreground rocks/plants, palette and cinematic light. Remove the ENTIRE central Korean title logo, castle-shaped sign, decorative gear/wrench emblem and any logo shadow, filling that space naturally with the distant dungeon architecture and mist. Remove the bottom-left skeleton character AND its toolbox, gears, loose traps, tools and character-related props, replacing with continuous stone floor and rocks. Remove the bottom-right teal-hooded repairman AND the trap he holds, replacing with continuous floor/rock ledge. Remove only the orange flames from the TWO foreground torch holders at left/right edges, leaving their metal sconces and warm light on the adjacent stone; flames are animated separately. No characters, no text, no letters, no logo, no buttons, no new symbols. Preserve the original geometry of the two foreground torch holders at about 7% and 94% of width, 31% of image height. Keep lower center floor dark and uncluttered for UI buttons. Full opaque 16:10 landscape image, same polished cute 3D game art style. Do NOT make an empty flat backdrop: keep the depth, arches, ruin walls and crystals.
prompts.logo: Edit target: the attached existing game title. Extract ONLY the large CENTRAL TITLE EMBLEM onto a genuinely transparent background. Preserve EXACT Korean title text and line breaks: first line "용사가", second line "지나간 자리". Keep the same ivory stone letters with gold beveled edges, dark teal shield backing, small castle wall crown with leaves, teal banner, and the gold gear crossed by a steel wrench beneath the words. Keep all the existing emblem pieces together as one clean silhouette. Preserve legibility and original word shapes, no new subtitle or changed wording. Remove the dungeon scenery, torches, ground, characters, toolbox, all other objects completely. Center the complete logo with clear transparent padding on all sides; no part clipped. Landscape logo, crisp polished 3D stylized fantasy game UI art, genuine alpha. No checkerboard, no glow rectangle, no background shadow beyond a tight natural edge shadow.
prompts.characters:
Reference: this existing 3D storybook title illustration. Create transparent animation assets matching EXACTLY its two cute characters, NOT comic-ink artwork. STRICT 4 columns x 2 rows sheet of EIGHT equally sized square cells with ample transparent gutters. No text, no grid lines, no background, no floor or ground shadows.
TOP ROW 4 successive loop poses of the SAME bottom-left goofy helmeted skeleton sitting with legs stretched out next to the SAME open brown toolbox and a few gold gears/tools. Plumed steel helmet, happy eyes, one hand holds up a small gold gear. Pose0 hand up baseline; pose1 raises gear 8 degrees and jaw smiles slightly; pose2 hand reaches 15 degrees up; pose3 hand returns 8 degrees, for a gentle wave loop 0-1-2-3. Keep torso, toolbox, pelvis, feet locked to same position/scale/baseline in each cell, all props inside cell.
BOTTOM ROW 4 poses of the SAME teal-hooded repairman at bottom-right, brass goggles on forehead, brown tool apron, boots, holding a brass spike trap with both hands, facing three-quarter LEFT. Full body in each. Pose0 sleepy eyes open; pose1 half-blink; pose2 eyes gently closed; pose3 relaxed sleepy open again. Small arm/chest breathing shift only; boots planted at identical baseline and same size. Preserve outfit/tools/trap through all cells. Natural subtle variation, never bouncing or walking. No extra characters or limbs. Both rows must preserve the original title's softly rendered miniature 3D look, colors and identity. All 8 cutouts true alpha transparency, no touching adjacent cells.
prompts.flames: Create ONE sprite sheet for an animated orange-gold torch flame in a polished cute 3D fantasy dungeon game. Transparent alpha background. STRICT 4 columns by 2 rows, EIGHT equal square cells, each contains one consecutive frame of the SAME flame, centered on an identical bottom anchor. A softly volumetric golden orange flame with bright creamy yellow core and three tapered curling tongues. Consecutive tongues sway gently left, upright, right and return in a smooth loop. Flame silhouette changes in every frame but base and scale consistent; small variation only. No torch holder, no wood, no props, no scenery, no smoke cloud, no text or gridlines. Generous fully transparent margins. Warm amber flame edges, clean translucency and real alpha, NOT a black rectangle or drawn checkerboard. Match the rendering style and warm foreground flames from the reference title.

cleanup.logo: Precise background extraction edit. Preserve the attached Korean game logo EXACTLY, especially the words 용사가 / 지나간 자리, all stone letters, gear/wrench, banner, castle blocks and leaves. Remove ALL background black/brown/golden gradient haze and all broad glow around the emblem. Every pixel outside the solid logo silhouette must be fully transparent alpha=0. Clean antialiasing only on the silhouette's immediate edge. No wide shadow or aura. Keep complete logo, same composition and resolution, generous transparent margins. Do NOT redesign or retype anything. Output true transparent PNG, not black or checkerboard.
cleanup.characters: Clean ONLY background transparency of this strict 4x2 sheet of 8 character sprites. Remove every pale gray/white/yellow/red background remnant, light aura, haze, glow, red noise and stray isolated pixels OUTSIDE the actual solid character and prop silhouettes. Empty gaps and gutters must be completely transparent alpha=0. Keep antialiasing only immediately on real contour edges. No shadows outside figures, no new background or text, no sprites touching adjacent cells. Preserve 4 columns and 2 rows and all eight poses. True alpha PNG.
